skills.name: mioku-developer
skills.description: Entry point for Mioku bot framework development: architecture, the four package types, startup order and its traps, and routing to the right specialised skill.

skills.name: mioku-plugin-dev
skills.description: Develop, modify or review Mioku plugins: definePlugin, ctx.command, ctx.handle, event routes, message segments, config and data, permissions, AISkill and ChatRuntime, publishing.

skills.name: mioku-service-dev
skills.description: Create or modify Mioku services that expose a reusable api object: MiokuService, init/dispose, defineService, getService, registerServiceConfig, publishing.

skills.name: mioku-adapter-dev
skills.description: Build or modify Mioku adapters that connect a platform: defineAdapter, apiVersion, event construction, capabilities, bot typing, the driver, OneBot v11 / icqq / QQ official.

skills.name: mioku-core-dev
skills.description: Work on the Mioku framework itself: runtime lifecycle, loader, event bus, command manager, capability registry, event correlator, builtin core plugin, CLI, build and verification.

skills.name: mioku-code-style
skills.description: Mioku coding conventions: package layout, file splitting, naming, TypeScript style, comment length, ctx.logger usage, git behaviour and when to bump a package version.

skills.name: mioku-debug
skills.description: Diagnose Mioku runtime problems: plugin will not load, service missing, adapter will not connect, commands not triggering, duplicate replies, silent permission denial, config not hot-reloading.
